description.p: A fast, unofficial app for Bitwarden and Vaultwarden vaults. Find a password, copy it and save a new one in a window that opens at once and stays small in memory.
It is built on rbw-ng, a command line Bitwarden client, and comes with its own copy: rbw-ng’s agent keeps your vault unlocked between uses and can serve the SSH keys stored in it.

ul.li: Several accounts side by side, on bitwarden.com, bitwarden.eu or your own server
Logins, cards, identities, notes and SSH keys to search, copy, create and edit
Verification codes that count down as you look
A generator for passwords, passphrases and PINs
The items used last and the generator in the system tray, where the desktop shows one
A copied password cleared after a while, and when the vault locks
rbw’s SSH agent set up and checked from Settings

description.p: The app isn’t made by Bitwarden, Inc. and isn’t affiliated with it.

screenshot.caption: A login, its password shown, in the dark style

description.p: Security hardening, faster syncs and polls with rbw-ng 1.19.0, and smoother rendering across large vaults.
